definitions.explanation: Individual parts used in electronic circuits and devices, such as resistors, capacitors, transistors, and integrated circuits. A key term in Japan's electronics manufacturing industry.

examples.japanese: {電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: There is a shortage of electronic components.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}している→生産する：01841_seisansuru⟧。
examples.english: This factory produces one million electronic components per year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{半導体|はんどうたい}→半導体：09248_handoutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はじめ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{供給|きょうきゅう}→供給：02599_kyoukyuu⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製造業|せいぞうぎょう}→製造業：14148_seizougyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The supply shortage of electronic components, especially semiconductors, affected manufacturing worldwide.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧ (electronic) and ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧ (parts, components). Japan has been a major global producer and exporter of electronic components, and this term appears frequently in business news, particularly during supply chain disruptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧: electronic component manufacturer
- {電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{供給|きょうきゅう}→供給：02599_kyoukyuu⟧: supply of electronic components
- {電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調達|ちょうたつ}→調達：09938_choutatsu⟧: procurement of electronic components
- {電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実装|じっそう}→実装：28631_jissou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mount electronic components (on a board)

EXAMPLES OF ELECTRONIC COMPONENTS:
- {抵抗器|ていこうき}: resistor
- コンデンサー: capacitor
- トランジスタ: transistor
- {集積回路|しゅうせきかいろ}(IC): integrated circuit
- ダイオード: diode

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{半導体|はんどうたい}→半導体：09248_handoutai⟧: semiconductor — a specific type of electronic component/material
- ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧: part, component — the general term for any machine part
- ⟦{電子|でんし}{機器|きき}→電子機器：18079_denshikiki⟧: electronic device/equipment — the finished product rather than components
